title: Application comparison
description: Compare application indicators over the same period.
selectionInstructions: Select two to five applications. Search and filters do not remove applications already selected.
selectionLimit: The five-application limit is reached. Remove one to select another.
referenceChanged: The reference application changed to the first remaining application.
invalidReference: Reference {{id}} is not among the selected applications. Choose a valid reference.
tooManySelected: More than five applications are selected. Remove applications to meet the limit.
selectAtLeastTwo: Select at least two applications to compare.
applicationNotFound: One or more applications were not found. Review the selection.
invalidReferenceError: The reference application is not valid for this selection.
emptyComparison: There are no usable results for these applications in this period.
partialComparison: This comparison is partial. Review coverage and reasons for unavailable values.
catalogError: Could not refresh the application catalog.
reason.ZERO_REFERENCE: Reference is zero; percentage cannot be calculated
reason.NON_POSITIVE_REFERENCE: Reference is not positive; percentage cannot be calculated
helpSelection: Choose two to five applications for the same period. Search, filters and pages help you find them without removing applications already selected. A valid selection or period change updates the comparison.
helpReference: The reference application is the baseline for differences, not a recommendation of the best application. Positive means more than the reference; negative means less. Check units and coverage: percentages may be unavailable, including when the reference is zero.
